title: Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (General) Bill 2020
short_title: Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (General) Bill 2020

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill is part of a package that would set up a national system for controlling industrial chemicals after they are sold, to protect the environment and human health.
The bill would let the government charge fees, set by regulation, to recover its costs of running the new system, except for customs and excise duties.
The charge would apply to services the Commonwealth provides under the Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Bill.
changes: Creates a cost recovery model for administering the industrial chemicals framework.
Allows charges to be prescribed by regulations.
Ensures the Commonwealth can recover its costs for services under the ICEMR Bill.
summary.affected: Companies and other entities that handle industrial chemicals and are subject to the new framework.

speeches.speaker: Sussan Ley
speeches.brief: The Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Bill 2020 establishes a national framework for managing environmental risks from industrial chemicals, with cost recovery charges to be set by regulations after consultation and not exceeding the cost of delivering the activity.

speeches.speaker: Sussan Ley
speeches.brief: The Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (Customs) Bill 2020 was moved for second reading as part of a framework to recover costs for administering the Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Bill 2020, imposing customs duty charges with amounts, liable persons, and exemptions to be set in regulations.

speeches.speaker: Sussan Ley
speeches.brief: The Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (Excise) Bill 2020 was moved for second reading as the final bill to enable cost recovery for administering the principal bill, with charges imposed only as excise duties and amounts set by regulations.
